body.name: Occurrence-coupled confidence enclosure
body.construction: Choose rational \(etahat\in Cn\) when \(Cn\neq\varnothing\), compute \(epsilon\), \(delta=\min\{1,\sum_r m_r\epsilon_r\}\), compute \([Lhat,Uhat]=H(etahat,[0,1])\), and return \(Kn=[\max\{0,Lhat-\delta\},\min\{1,Uhat+\delta\}]\); return \([0,1]\) when \(Cn=\varnothing\).
